legend: Coronal CT of the orbits in the same patient as in <<38078>> showing a left inferomedial orbital mass with involvement of the ethmoidal sinuses.
source: Antonio Augusto Cruz,Department of Ophthalmology, School of Medicine of Ribeirão Preto, University of São Paulo, Brazil

legend: Biopsy in a case of Rosai–Dorfman disease showing a collection of histiocytes, lymphocytes, plasma cells (with Russell body), and typical emperipolesis.
source: Fernando Chahud, Pathology Department, School of Medicine of Ribeirão-Preto, University of São Paulo, São Paulo, Brazil.

legend: The histiocytes in Rosai–Dorfman disease express reaction to S100 stain. Note the lymphocytes that are engulfed by the macrophage in the centre of the photo.
A mixed infiltrate of histiocytes with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm and lymphocytes.
Rosai–Dorfman disease infiltrate showing features of emperipolesis and Russell bodies.
source: Azza Maktabi, Pathology & Laboratory Medicine Department, KKESH

legend: Axial and coronal T1-weighted postcontrast MRI shows a lesion involving the superotemporal right orbit and right upper eyelid (arrows).
Axial (A) and coronal (B) T1-weighted postcontrast MRI shows a heterogeneously enhancing lesion in the right lacrimal gland and superotemporal right orbit (arrows).
A case of Rosai–Dorfman disease in a female patient presenting at the age of 32 years with left proptosis and superior displacement of the left globe due to an inferomedial orbital mass.
